title: O Lord, My Best Desire Fulfil
description: O Lord, My Best Desire Fulfil in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: William Cowper wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 619 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Resignation and Trust”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O Lord, my best de-sire ful-fil, And help me to re-sign Life, health and com-fort to thy will, And make thy plea-sure mine.

lines: O Lord, my best desire fulfil,
Life, health and comfort to thy will,
Why should I shrink at thy command,
Or tremble at thy gracious hand
No! let me rather freely yield
What most I prize, to thee;
Who never hast a good withheld,
But ah! my inmost spirit cries,
Still bind me to thy sway;
Else the next cloud that veils the skies,

licence: Public domain: William Cowper died in 1800.
credits: Words by William Cowper (1731–1800), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
